t: 威廉·劳德大主教在伦敦塔被以叛国罪斩首.
te: Archbishop William Laud is beheaded for treason at the Tower of London.
dz: 威廉·劳德大主教在伦敦塔被以叛国罪斩首.
de: Archbishop William Laud is beheaded for treason at the Tower of London.

t: 在苏格兰,因弗洛希之战使皇家/爱尔兰取得了胜利.
te: In Scotland, the Battle of Inverlochy results in a Royalist/Irish victory.
dz: 三国之战:在苏格兰,因弗洛希之战使皇家/爱尔兰取得了胜利.
de: Wars of the Three Kingdoms: In Scotland, the Battle of Inverlochy results in a Royalist/Irish victory.

t: 蒙特罗斯勋爵手下的苏格兰王室主义势力击败了约翰·乌里手下的约克人势力.
te: Scottish Royalist forces under Lord Montrose defeat Covenanter forces under John Urry.
dz: 蒙特罗斯勋爵手下的苏格兰王室主义势力击败了约翰·乌里手下的约克人势力.

t: 从明到清的过渡时期的一部分,扬州市居民被屠杀了十天.
te: The ten day massacre of the residents of the city of Yangzhou, part of the Transition from Ming to Qing.
dz: 扬州大屠杀:从明到清的过渡时期的一部分,扬州市居民被屠杀了十天.
de: Yangzhou massacre: The ten day massacre of the residents of the city of Yangzhou, part of the Transition from Ming to Qing.

t: 拿西比之战:一万二千名皇家军队被一万五千名议员士兵所打.
te: Battle of Naseby: Twelve thousand Royalist forces are beaten by fifteen thousand Parliamentarian soldiers.
dz: 英国内战:拿西比之战:一万二千名皇家军队被一万五千名议员士兵所打.
de: English Civil War: Battle of Naseby: Twelve thousand Royalist forces are beaten by fifteen thousand Parliamentarian soldiers.

t: 三国之战:阿尔福德之战.
dz: 三国之战:阿尔福德之战.
de: Wars of the Three Kingdoms: Battle of Alford.

t: 英国内战:兰波特战役发生.
te: The Battle of Langport takes place.
dz: 英国内战:兰波特战役发生.
de: English Civil War: The Battle of Langport takes place.

t: 清朝摄政王多尔衮颁布法令，命令所有汉族男子剃去前额，并将其余的头发编成与满族相同的辫子。
te: Qing dynasty regent Dorgon issues an edict ordering all Han Chinese men to shave their forehead and braid the rest of t…
dz: 清朝摄政王多尔衮颁布法令，命令所有汉族男子剃去前额，并将其余的头发编成与满族相同的辫子。
de: Qing dynasty regent Dorgon issues an edict ordering all Han Chinese men to shave their forehead and braid the rest of their hair into a queue identical to those of the Manchus.

t: 莱文伯爵手下的苏格兰殖民者出动赫雷福德之围(英语:Siege of Hereford)所剩有的…
te: Scottish Covenanter forces under the Earl of Leven launch the Siege of Hereford, a remaining Royalist stronghold.
dz: 英格兰内战:莱文伯爵手下的苏格兰殖民者出动赫雷福德之围(英语:Siege of Hereford)所剩有的皇家主义据点.
de: English Civil War: Scottish Covenanter forces under the Earl of Leven launch the Siege of Hereford, a remaining Royalist stronghold.

t: 第二次诺德林根战役见证了法国军队击败神圣罗马帝国军队。
te: The Second Battle of Nördlingen sees French forces defeating those of the Holy Roman Empire.
dz: 三十年战争：第二次诺德林根战役见证了法国军队击败神圣罗马帝国军队。
de: Thirty Years' War: The Second Battle of Nördlingen sees French forces defeating those of the Holy Roman Empire.

t: 瑞典和丹麦签署布伦塞布罗和平.
te: Sweden and Denmark sign the Peace of Brömsebro.
dz: 瑞典和丹麦签署布伦塞布罗和平.
de: Sweden and Denmark sign the Peace of Brömsebro.

t: 蒙特罗斯侯爵手下的一支皇家军队在基尔西斯之战中击败了一支约克军队.
te: A Royalist army under the Marquess of Montrose defeats a Covenanter army in the battle of Kilsyth.
dz: 蒙特罗斯侯爵手下的一支皇家军队在基尔西斯之战中击败了一支约克军队.
de: A Royalist army under the Marquess of Montrose defeats a Covenanter army in the battle of Kilsyth.

t: 苏格兰的约法会势力放弃了他们长达一个月的塞克(英语:Siege of Hereford),一个…
te: Scottish Covenanter forces abandon their month-long Siege of Hereford, a Cavalier stronghold, on news of Royalist victo…
dz: 英国内战:苏格兰的约法会势力放弃了他们长达一个月的塞克(英语:Siege of Hereford),一个卡瓦利埃据点,在苏格兰的皇家主义胜利的消息上.
de: English Civil War: Scottish Covenanter forces abandon their month-long Siege of Hereford, a Cavalier stronghold, on news of Royalist victories in Scotland.

t: 苏格兰皇家主义者在菲利浦之战被约克人所击败.
te: Scottish Royalists are defeated by Covenanters at the Battle of Philiphaugh.
dz: 三国之战:苏格兰皇家主义者在菲利浦之战被约克人所击败.
de: Wars of the Three Kingdoms: Scottish Royalists are defeated by Covenanters at the Battle of Philiphaugh.

t: 英格兰的罗顿·希斯战役(英语:Battle of Rowton Heath)也相继发生,以议会…
te: The Battle of Rowton Heath in England occurs, ending in a Parliamentarian victory over a Royalist army commanded in per…
dz: 英格兰的罗顿·希斯战役(英语:Battle of Rowton Heath)也相继发生,以议会党人战胜由国王查理一世亲自指挥的皇家军队而结束.
de: The Battle of Rowton Heath in England occurs, ending in a Parliamentarian victory over a Royalist army commanded in person by King Charles I.

t: 珍妮·曼斯在蒙特利尔开设了北美第一所非专业医院.
te: Jeanne Mance opens the first lay hospital of North America in Montreal.
dz: 珍妮·曼斯在蒙特利尔开设了北美第一所非专业医院.
de: Jeanne Mance opens the first lay hospital of North America in Montreal.
